metadata.title: 21 CFR Part 11 - Electronic Records; Electronic Signatures

controls.title: Validation of systems
controls.statement: Validation of systems to ensure accuracy, reliability, consistent intended performance, and the ability to discern invalid or altered records.

controls.title: Protection of records
controls.statement: Protection of records to enable their accurate and ready retrieval throughout the records retention period.

controls.title: Limiting system access
controls.statement: Limiting system access to authorized individuals.

controls.title: Secure, computer-generated audit trails
controls.statement: Use of secure, computer-generated, time-stamped audit trails to independently record the date and time of operator entries and actions that create, modify, or delete electronic records.

controls.title: Identification code and password controls
controls.statement: Ensuring that identification code and password issuances are periodically checked, recalled, or revised.
